checks.description: A line unit inside the reach of an enemy tower that outranges it stepped out while our arty/msam stood within 14 cells of that tower. Last fight the riflemen first took tower fire at 5.7-6.0 cells at 577s, when the arty was about 14 cells out and closing, so this would have fired then. Absent means no push met an outranging tower with siege in position, or the rule never ran.

A line unit held 1-4 cells outside an outranging tower's reach, with nothing in its own reach, while siege shelled the tower. Absent alongside a passing stand-off-steps-out means every held unit had something to screen (assault.stand-off-screen), not that the rule is wrong.

Holding line units at a tower's edge must not stall the assault. The hold ends when the tower dies, when no siege piece is in position, or after 45 seconds of standing off in a unit's life. Last fight 33 enemy buildings destroyed; 8 is the fitness reference.
No fight may run past the benchmark's 2,400s limit. A timed-out benchmark game voids its pair, and three voided pairs stop training.
Guards the previous round's refinery-before-tech order, still in the code. Last fight peaked at 9 harvesters against the opponent's 6.

The only fitness component short of 1.0 last fight: mean army 4,775 against 6,000, score 0.796. The first push fell from 4,650 to 1,400 and 4,300 of its 9,700 lost went at one gun/gtwr pair (13 e1, then 5 unscreened arty). Diagnostic: dominated by the opponent and the match length.

Last fight 9 of 27 arty died, five of them at 603-610s to enemy infantry after the screening riflemen had died at the towers. Diagnostic: depends on how many arty the match builds and how many pushes it runs.
